messages.subject: For Juan Luciano | Agribusiness, government relations and supply-chain stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Walsh,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Juan Luciano, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

ADM operates at the intersection of global trade, agriculture, biofuels, sustainability and complex supply chains. That combination of external policy and operating execution closely matches my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement and cross-functional coordination across complex operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this experience might support ADM's government-relations, sustainability or international stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to ADM.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
